name: Kidotta Onna ni Busaiku Idenshi o Tanetsuke Sasero!!
original_name: 気取った女に不細工遺伝子を種付けさせろっ!!
source:
Holier-than-thou ladies get f*cked full of ugly! 

The protagonist has had enough of his high and mighty boss. 
He f*cks her full of baby batter in the presidential office, the toilet, anytime, anywhere, 
but the best revenge is her lifelong burden of an ugly baby. 

* Story 
I spent my life at this company. 
When my father suddenly died and bitchy boss Mei Takamura took over, 
she cut me right out of the business. I was immediately fired. 
Why? Because "I don't like your ugly face," she said. 
Outrage doesn't begin to describe it. 

I was jobless. 
Circumstances led me to a part-time janitor position, and I got dispatched to my 
old building. I went to Mei Takamura and fell on hands and knees begging, as I'm sure 
she wanted me to do. But she didn't even recognize me. 
"Who the hell are you? Make this ugly man go away"

That was the last straw. "I'll make sure you never forget this face!" I vowed. 

She'll remember me, all right. 

Every time she looks at her kid...
translation:
自以为高人一等的女人，被丑陋之物操到饱！

主角受够了那个趾高气扬的女上司。
他在总裁办公室、厕所，随时随地把精液射满她的身体，
但最棒的复仇，是让她一辈子背负一个丑陋的孩子。

*故事
我把一生都奉献给了这家公司。
父亲突然去世后，刻薄的女上司高村芽衣接管公司，
她把我彻底赶出企业，立即将我解雇。
为什么？她说：“我不喜欢你那张丑脸。”
这根本无法用愤怒来形容。

我失业了。
机缘巧合之下，我找到一份兼职清洁工的工作，被派回原来的大楼。
我去找高村芽衣，像她想看的那样跪地哀求。可她甚至没认出我。
“你到底是谁？让这个丑男人滚开。”

那是压垮我的最后一根稻草。“我会让你永远忘不了这张脸！”我发誓。

她当然会记住我。

每当她看着自己的孩子时……
